title: Sam Altman revealed AGI is 2 years away

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Sam Altman’s timeline is backed by real progress in transformer scaling and reinforcement learning from human feedback. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: AGI in two years ignores the massive gaps in common sense reasoning and real-world adaptability that even GPT-4 can’t solve. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: OpenAI’s recent work on aligned AI and the use of RLHF show a clear roadmap toward safe, scalable AGI—unlike fragmented efforts elsewhere. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Altman’s timeline assumes perfect alignment and no regulatory or ethical roadblocks—both of which are impossible to predict or control. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: AGI in two years is hype without the infrastructure or societal readiness to handle its implications. (4 sec)
